name: str_date_parse_entity_attr_value
source_sql: SELECT eav_id AS "eav_id", TO_DATE(created_dt DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'DD-MON-YY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS "created_dt_parsed" FROM ow_billing.entity_attr_value ORDER BY eav_id
target_sql: SELECT eav_id, created_dt_parsed FROM billing.entity_attr_value ORDER BY eav_id
